name: Attention, Dear Passengers
summary:
Welcome aboard Flight ROSE-204. It should have been an ordinary flight. Then the cabin starts to break apart.

Attention, Dear Passengers is a single-player, physics-driven survival game where every round turns a routine flight into a fight to stay upright. Brace in your seat, move through a collapsing cabin, avoid dangerous debris, and keep going after the wreck hits the ground.

You are not alone. Six AI passengers react to the disaster around them: some seek safety, some panic, and some make a bad situation worse. Grab a passenger when the moment calls for it, pull them from danger, or fight to keep your own footing while the world shifts beneath you.

Each flight uses fresh random seeds for its disaster events. Lightning, ruptures, decompression, floods, fire, acid rain, aftershocks, and tornadoes can reshape the round and force a new survival plan.
